title: pilot-declared-public-data-basis/1
description: The declared-public-data basis of the lab-to-endpoint pilot's run of record (D-LE-14). Owner: this framework, runners/public-data-admission.ts (publicDataAdmissionOf). Producer: the QA owner, by hand, as a file in the tree holding QA-RETENTION-ROOT; no code creates it. An R2 run summary cites it by relative path (pilot.classification.basisRef) and SHA-256 (pilot.classification.basisSha256). A package admitted under it keeps a byte copy as evidence/public-data-basis.json. The basis carries no signature; it records who filed it, and approval stays a governance decision in the eTMF.

study.description: The pilot study the basis covers.

runKind.description: Only the run of record is admitted. R1 keeps the synthetic classification (D-LE-14).

decisions.description: The decision ids the basis rests on; must include D-LE-1 (CDISC data use) and D-LE-14 (evidence classification).

dataUseManifestSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the lab-to-endpoint.data-use-manifest/1 file the QA owner read when filing.

keySetManifestSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the sealed, countersigned key set manifest the run of record states as pilot.keySet.manifestSha256. A run under another key set is not admitted, and resealing the keys needs a new filing.

filedBy.description: The person who filed the basis.

filedRole.description: The role that person held, for example QA owner (interim).

filedAt.description: An RFC 3339 instant before the run's pilot.startedAt; a basis filed later is not admitted.
